name: SandTimeCountdown
job: Count down to a launch, sale or event as an hourglass whose grains of sand fall in proportion to the time left, with days, hours and minutes printed on the base
visitor_action: none; hover flips the glass briefly to a lively state
mobile: smaller glass, fewer grains, numbers below
motion: grains stream and pile with gravity physics in canvas, the pile slowly shifts with real time (reduced-motion: static glass at the right fill, numbers only)
art_direction: Observatory brass: midnight-teal backdrop, brushed brass frame, pale gold sand with warm glints, cream numerals
